snippet.title: PlantUp - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🎉 **PlantUp is available to wishlist on Steam starting TODAY!**

➡️ Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4891650/PlantUp/

📅 **Release Date: October 8, 2026**

🌱 Welcome to **PlantUp** – where cozy gardening meets organized chaos!

Grow plants, harvest crops, process them into valuable products, and serve impatient customers before they lose their patience. Build the perfect workflow, unlock powerful upgrades, and transform your tiny plant shop into a thriving business.

Whether you enjoy farming games, management sims, or fast-paced time management games, PlantUp combines relaxing gardening with increasingly hectic gameplay.

🌿 Features:
• Grow vegetables, fruit trees, and flowers
• Process your harvest into soups, smoothies, popcorn, bouquets, and more
• Serve customers before they run out of patience
• Unlock upgrades, machines, and powerful cards
• Play Campaign and Endless Mode
• Turn chaos into an efficient production system

If you enjoyed games like PlateUp!, Overcooked, or other management games, don't forget to wishlist PlantUp and follow the journey!

#PlantUp #Steam #IndieGame #Gaming #FarmingGame #ManagementGame #TimeManagement #CozyGames #Simulation #IndieDev
